exchanges.original: Ce nageur est plus rapide que les autres.
exchanges.translated: This swimmer is faster than the others.

exchanges.original: Ce nageur va dépasser tous les autres.
exchanges.translated: This swimmer will surpass all the others.

exchanges.original: Ce najeur a un style très personnel.
exchanges.translated: This swimmer has a very personal style.

exchanges.original: Je ne suis pas certain qu'il va arriver à finir la course.
exchanges.translated: I'm not sure he'll be able to finish the race.

exchanges.original: J’espère que les vagues ne vont pas encore grossir.
exchanges.translated: I hope the waves don't get any bigger.

exchanges.original: Si le vent continue à soufler aussi fort, le comité d'organisation va annuler la course.
exchanges.translated: If the wind continues to blow this strongly, the organizing committee will cancel the race.

exchanges.original: Le vent est faible et il n'y a pas de vagues.
exchanges.translated: The wind is light and there are no waves.

exchanges.original: Il ne faut pas trop se rapprocher des nageurs ni des autres bateaux
exchanges.translated: You shouldn't get too close to the swimmers or the other boats.
